violations.description: Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface Fans were not cleaned as frequently as required. Remove/clean dust/dirt debris from fans.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)* were not maintained in good repair. Several floor tiles have come loose creating a trip hazard. Repair or replace tiles.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Fan Guards in walk-in-cooler need cleaned of debris.
